name: ClinPharmStats
author: Shaun Porwal
summary: ClinPharmStats provides biostatistics and statistical programming services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. The services support clinical trials.
profile: ClinPharmStats is a New Jersey corporation.
The About page gives 1999 as the start year.

services.name: Biostatistics
services.summary: Statistical analysis for early phase clinical trials.

services.name: Statistical Programming
services.summary: Programming in SAS, R and Python for clinical trial data.

services.name: Early Drug Development
services.summary: Support for early phase drug development.

engagement: Staff work in functional roles on client projects, on site or by remote access to client systems.
Staff also work as independent statisticians and independent programmers for un-blinded analysis.
